u0: Initial carrying phase: the purple box is in your hands and no fall is awaiting recovery. Continue toward the green exit while keeping the box. If the box slips out of your hands, you must recover it on the very next move.
u1: The box has just fallen for the first time and is not in your hands. This is a one-step recovery window: your very next move must pick the box up again. A successful pickup returns you to carrying the box; failing to pick it up next leads to failure.
u2: You are carrying the box again after a fall and no fall is currently awaiting pickup. Continue toward the exit while holding the box. If it falls again, you will enter another immediate-recovery window and must pick it up on the very next move.
u3: The box has fallen again and is not in your hands. You are in another one-step recovery window: pick it up on the very next move. Success returns you to carrying the box; otherwise the run fails.
u4: Failure sink: you reached the exit without the box or failed to pick it up immediately after a fall. The task can no longer succeed, and no further reward is available.
u5: Success sink: you reached the exit while carrying the box. The task is complete and the full reward has been earned.
